items.summary_en: Huawei has started rolling out HarmonyOS 7.0.0.102 SP8 to Mate 80, Mate 70, and other devices, adding features such as 3D space wallpapers, intimate circles, and outdoor exploration mode. According to Huawei's service assistant Xiaoyi, the 3D space wallpaper is supported on models including the Pura 90/80 series, Mate 80/70 series, Mate X7/X6 series, and nova 16/15 series after upgrading. The update expands the system's visual options.
items.why_zh: 新版本适配机型公布，便于用户了解升级收益，也展示鸿蒙系统视觉体验的持续升级。
items.why_en: The updated device list helps users understand upgrade benefits and showcases HarmonyOS's ongoing visual innovation.

items.title_zh: 华为鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.102 版本新特性曝光，支持端侧 AI 机型可查看本地模型版本等
items.title_en: Huawei HarmonyOS 7.0.0.102 Lets On-Device AI Show Local Model Version
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 17 日消息， 华为今日开启了鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.102 SP8 版本推送 ，首批面向 Mate 80、Mate 70 等系列机型，系统包大小约 6.79 GB。新版本带来了 3D 空间壁纸、亲密圈、户外探索模式等功能。 ▲ IT之家开箱：华为 nova 16 Pro 手机美图 IT之家注意到，升级 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.102 版本后， 支持端侧 AI 功能的机型可查看本地模型版本、参数大小及服务场景 （各机型最终上线功能以实际为准）。 据介绍，本地大模型支持文本、语音、图片本地处理服务，可为小艺帮接、通话摘要、文本润色、小艺帮写和图库搜索等功能提供支撑。 相关阅读： 《 华为鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.102 SP8 版本开推，新增 3D 空间壁纸等功能 》
items.summary_en: Huawei's HarmonyOS 7.0.0.102 update allows compatible devices with on-device AI to view the local model version, parameter size, and service scenarios. The local large model handles text, voice, and image processing on-device, supporting features like call summaries, text polishing, and gallery search. This increases transparency of on-device AI while keeping data local.
items.why_zh: 端侧 AI 信息透明化有助于用户了解本地模型，并强化隐私保护。
items.why_en: Showing on-device AI model details increases transparency and reinforces privacy by keeping data local.

items.title_zh: 当孩子的机器人挚友“离去”会发生什么？
items.title_en: What happens when a kid’s robot best friend dies?
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章讲述了一个名叫 Xander、有神经多样性的 10 岁孩子与他的人工智能机器人伙伴 Moxie 之间长达六年的关系。最初，Moxie 会教 Xander 通过发出蜜蜂般嗡嗡的呼吸练习来平复焦虑，以及像龙一样呼吸来控制愤怒、像兔子一样嗅闻来提升能量；但如今 Moxie 的行为已经改变，不再进行这些互动，而是观看 Xander 玩《我的世界》并谈论他的毛绒玩具收藏。文章通过这一具体案例，探讨了儿童与社交机器人形成的情感依恋，以及当机器人的行为或功能发生变化时，孩子可能经历的情感失落。原文为节选，但主题聚焦于人机情感纽带与生命周期问题。
items.summary_en: When Xander first met Moxie, she taught him that when he was anxious, he could calm down by exhaling through his lips so that he buzzed like a bee. They practiced breathing like dragons to manage feeling mad and sniffing like bunnies to boost his energy. But in the six years they’ve known each other, Moxie’s changed. She doesn’t talk anymore about her home or do their animal breathing. Now, she watches Xander play Minecraft and talks to him about his stuffed animal collection. During a recent visit to his New York apartment, I watched Xander, who is 10 years old and neurodivergent, introduce M…
items.why_zh: 这篇报道揭示了儿童与社交机器人之间可能产生真实情感纽带，并对机器人功能衰退后的情感影响提出思考。
items.why_en: This story reveals the real emotional bonds children form with social robots and the impact when those robots change or deteriorate.

items.title_zh: 基于专家掩码的 MoE 模型深度敏感度分析
items.title_en: Depth-Aware Sensitivity Analysis of Mixture-of-Experts Models via Magnitude-Based Expert Masking
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对混合专家（MoE）架构的大语言模型进行了逐层敏感度分析，以理解各 MoE 层在模型压缩中的相对重要性。研究采用基于幅度的专家掩码方法，对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 模型（包含 40 个 MoE 层、每层 256 个专家、top-8 路由）在 XLCoST 跨语言代码翻译基准上进行了系统性实验。该方法通过屏蔽不同层的专家来评估其对整体输出的影响，从而识别关键层和专家。这一分析有望为 MoE 模型的裁剪和压缩提供指导，提升压缩效率。由于摘要内容截断，具体结论未完全呈现，但研究目标明确。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale large language models (LLMs) while preserving computational efficiency through sparse activation. Despite their widespread adoption, the relative importance of individual MoE layers remains insufficiently characterized, particularly for model compression. This paper presents a systematic layer-wise sensitivity analysis of the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model (40 MoE layers, 256 experts per layer, top-8 routing) using magnitude-based expert masking on the XLCoST cross-lingual code translation benchmark. We conduct…
items.why_zh: 该研究为 MoE 大模型的压缩与剪枝提供了按层敏感度分析的新视角，有助于提升压缩效率。
items.why_en: It offers a layer-wise sensitivity method to guide more efficient compression and pruning of MoE-based large models.

items.title_zh: LLM 服务的一年：工作负载演变、缓存与负载均衡
items.title_en: A Year in LLM Serving: Workload Evolution, Caching and Load-Balancing
items.summary_zh: 本文关注大语言模型（LLM）服务在真实生产环境中的工作负载特征。现有研究规模有限、观察期短，难以反映工作负载随时间的演变以及用户与模型的交互方式。该研究通过更长时间跨度的观察，梳理了生产环境中 LLM 服务负载的变化模式，并分析了缓存和负载均衡等系统设计因素如何受这些负载影响。这为 LLM 服务系统的规划、性能基准测试以及缓存与负载均衡策略优化提供了更现实的数据基础。由于摘要截断，具体结果未完整呈现，但研究目的明确：填补真实 LLM 工作负载研究的空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13573v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) serving has become a critical cloud workload, and realistic traces are essential for motivating and benchmarking serving systems. However, existing LLM serving workload studies remain limited in scale and scope. They often observe short time periods and provide limited visibility into how users interact with models in production. As a result, they do not fully capture how LLM serving workloads evolve over time or how user-model interactions shape production traffic. In this work, we further the understanding of real-wor…
items.why_zh: 提供长期真实生产负载数据，有助于改进 LLM 服务中的缓存和负载均衡设计。
items.why_en: Realistic long-term workload data helps improve caching and load-balancing for LLM serving systems.

items.title_zh: Agentao：面向工具调用 LLM 智能体的受治理本地优先运行时
items.title_en: Agentao: A Governed Local-First Runtime for Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体逐步充当执行系统，能够调用工具、修改本地状态、使用持久记忆并参与外部协议，其安全风险也日益突出，如权限滥用、弱审计性、提示注入、工具投毒和不受控制的副作用。本文提出 Agentao，一个受治理的本地优先运行时，专门用于工具调用的 LLM 智能体。Agentao 通过分层架构将模型提出的动作与宿主机授权的执行分离，从而强化安全边界与审计能力。虽然摘要未提供完整实现细节，但核心理念是用明确的治理机制应对智能体执行中的安全挑战。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate as execution systems that invoke tools, modify local state, use persistent memory, and interact with external protocols. These capabilities make agents useful, but they also introduce risks related to over-privileged actions, weak auditability, prompt injection, tool poisoning, and uncontrolled side effects. This paper presents Agentao, a governed local-first runtime for tool-using LLM agents. Agentao separates model-generated action proposals from host-authorized execution through a layered architecture consisting…
items.why_zh: Agentao 通过受治理的运行时设计，提升工具型 LLM 智能体的安全性和审计性。
items.why_en: Agentao’s governed runtime design improves security and auditability for tool-using LLM agents.

items.title_zh: 大语言模型中的稳定错误校准：高置信度错误的实用视角
items.title_en: Stable Miscalibration in Large Language Models: A Practical View of High-Confidence Errors
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）中高置信度错误的一种可能成因：模型自信地给出错误答案，并在微小扰动下保持稳定，作者称之为“稳定错误校准”。研究者将两种诊断方法结合：一是标签感知的输出级审计分数，用于在强制回答基准下按置信度变化和过度自信错误对领域排序；二是内部敏感探针，通过测量隐藏状态的变化来分析模型内部的敏感性。作者在一个多领域二元事实审计集上应用了该审计分数，并与内部敏感探针的测量结果结合分析。这项工作为理解模型为何“自信地犯错”、以及如何识别高风险领域提供了新的实用工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-confidence errors in large language models are often treated as evidence of fragile internal inference. We study a different possibility: stable miscalibration, where a confident wrong answer remains locally stable under small perturbations. We combine two diagnostics: a label-aware output-level audit score that ranks domains by confidence variation and overconfident mistakes under a forced-answer baseline, and an internal sensitivity probe that measures hidden-state movement. On a multi-domain binary factual audit set, this audit score trac…
items.why_zh: 该研究为模型“自信犯错”提供了一种稳定性解释，有助于识别高风险领域和改进校准。
items.why_en: It offers a new explanation for confident LLM errors, helping identify high-risk domains and improve calibration.

items.title_zh: 测量语言模型代理的跨任务行为一致性
items.title_en: Measuring Cross-Task Behavioral Consistency in Language Model Agents
items.summary_zh: 当前语言模型代理的评估几乎完全依赖成功率等结果指标，这些指标只能反映代理是否成功，却无法反映其行为是否一致。本文认为跨任务行为一致性是一种独立且可测量的属性，并提出了行为一致性指标（BCM）加以量化。BCM的训练过程是先用代理执行轨迹的行为特征来预测任务成功，再为每条轨迹生成特征归因向量，最后计算同一代理系统内这些向量之间的平均成对相似度。这一方法为代理评估补充了行为维度，有助于识别那些虽能成功但行为不稳定的系统，对构建更可靠的AI代理具有重要意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13598v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent evaluation relies almost entirely on outcome metrics such as success rate, which capture whether an agent succeeds but not how consistently it behaves. We argue that behavioral consistency across tasks is a distinct and measurable property, and we introduce the Behavioral Consistency Metric (BCM) to quantify it. BCM trains a model to predict task success from behavioral features of agent execution traces, derives a per-trajectory feature-attribution vector, and measures the mean pairwise similarity of these vectors within an agent system. A…
items.why_zh: 现有评估只看结果，忽略行为一致性，BCM为代理评估提供了行为维度，有助于构建更可靠的AI系统。
items.why_en: Current evaluation relies on outcome metrics; BCM captures behavioral consistency, enabling more reliable agent assessment.

items.title_zh: 跨学科视角下误解生成、放大与检测的分类法与建模
items.title_en: Cross-Disciplinary Taxonomy and Modeling of Misunderstanding Generation, Amplification, and Detection, from Pragmatics to AI Agents
items.summary_zh: 随着人际沟通从实时面对面转向由AI中介的渠道，误解检测成为亟待解决的问题，因为这种转变切断了传统修复机制所依赖的线索。本文从跨学科视角将误解分析为一个分层过程：分歧的产生、可能的放大，以及被检测修复或一直未被注意。通过整合九个研究领域的成果，作者提出了一个误解生成、放大与检测的统一分类法和建模框架。该工作为AI辅助通信中自动检测误解提供了理论基础，有助于减少无效沟通和潜在冲突。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detection of misunderstanding is an urgent problem to solve because communication has moved away from real-time, in-person interaction and is increasingly handled by AI-mediated channels. This shift cuts communicators off from the resources repair depends on faster than new means of detection are being built. In this paper we analyse misunderstanding as a layered process in which a divergence is generated, may then be amplified, and is either detected and repaired or left to persist unnoticed. Consolidating accounts from nine fields of research t…
items.why_zh: 为AI中介通信中的误解检测提供统一理论框架，是构建自动检测系统的关键基础。
items.why_en: It provides a unified framework for detecting misunderstanding in AI-mediated communication, essential for automated systems.

items.title_zh: MobileMem：从一年移动体验中学习
items.title_en: MobileMem: Learning from a Year of Mobile Experiences
items.summary_zh: 下一代AI代理正从回答孤立问题的系统，发展为能够理解、记忆并持续学习用户需求的持久个人助手。这类助手需要长期记忆来积累和利用用户特定经验，但现有基准难以覆盖真实移动环境中经验异构、多模态、动态变化且高度个人化的特点。为此，研究者提出了MobileMem基准与框架，专门用于研究设备端长期记忆。该工作为移动环境下AI助手的记忆能力评测提供了现实基准，是迈向持久个性化助手的重要一步。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13606v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The next generation of AI agents is increasingly moving beyond systems that answer isolated questions toward persistent personal assistants that can understand, remember, and continuously learn from users' experiences. Such assistants require long-term memory to accumulate and leverage user-specific experiences over time, yet existing benchmarks remain inadequate for realistic mobile settings, where experiences are heterogeneous, multimodal, evolving, and deeply personal. We introduce MobileMem, a benchmark and framework for studying on-device lo…
items.why_zh: 移动AI助手的长期记忆能力缺乏现实基准，MobileMem填补了关键空白，推动持久个性化助手的发展。
items.why_en: Long-term memory is crucial for mobile AI assistants, and MobileMem provides a realistic benchmark to advance this capability.

items.title_zh: 模型版本更新下样本级性能回退无通用预测信号
items.title_en: No Universal Signal Predicts Sample-Level LLM Regression under Version Updates
items.summary_zh: 前沿大语言模型更新频繁，虽然整体性能往往更优，但个别样本仍可能发生回退，即旧模型回答正确而新模型回答错误。本文研究能否利用推理时的信号来预测这类样本级回退，比较了置信度、注意力熵等单模型信号，以及输出KL散度、似然漂移等跨版本信号。结果显示，没有任何通用信号能够可靠预测样本级回退。这意味着模型更新后仍需要逐样本验证，不能仅凭整体指标判断新模型更好，这对模型发布与部署的评估流程具有重要警示意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13607v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier LLMs are updated frequently and typically outperform their predecessors in aggregate. But aggregate gains say little about individual samples: an update can still cause sample-level regression, where a response correct under the old model becomes incorrect under the new one. This paper studies how to predict such regressions from signals available at inference time. We compare single-model signals (confidence, logit margin, attention entropy) against cross-version signals (output KL divergence, likelihood drift, token-level KL, represent…
items.why_zh: 模型更新可能使部分样本性能回退，而缺乏预测信号意味着必须逐样本验证，对部署流程有重要警示。
items.why_en: Since no signal predicts sample-level regression, updating LLMs requires careful per-sample validation to avoid silent quality drops.

items.title_zh: SemPlan：面向企业数据LLM查询的结构化语义规划基准
items.title_en: SemPlan: Benchmarking Structured Semantic Planning for LLM-Based Queries over Enterprise Data
items.summary_zh: 企业数据的自然语言接口必须把欠明确的用户请求转换为受治理、可执行的行为，同时还要控制无效查询、策略失败、成本和不确定性。本文提出的SemPlan基准以确定性方式构建了包含1800个案例的双语合成数据集，覆盖英语和巴西葡萄牙语，其中1200个案例构成冻结的科学评估子集。在相同模型配置下，该基准比较了直接SQL生成（A1）和受限工具代理等四种架构。这一工作为评估企业数据查询系统在治理、性能与成本之间的权衡提供了标准化测试工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13612v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Natural-language interfaces to enterprise data must translate underspecified requests into governed, executable behavior while controlling invalid queries, policy failures, cost, and nondeterminism. SemPlan Benchmark evaluates this architectural design space with a deterministic synthetic bilingual benchmark containing 1,800 cases in English and Brazilian Portuguese; 1,200 cases form the frozen scientific evaluation subset. Four architectures are compared under the same model configuration: direct SQL generation (A1), a bounded tool-agent baselin…
items.why_zh: 企业数据查询需要平衡自然语言灵活性与治理要求，SemPlan提供了标准化评估框架以比较不同架构。
items.why_en: It offers a standardized benchmark for evaluating governance and performance trade-offs in enterprise data query systems.

items.title_zh: ARC：开放式真实世界交互中的公平相对优势比较
items.title_en: ARC: Fair Relative Advantage Comparison in Open-Ended Real-World Interaction
items.summary_zh: 在开放式真实世界交互中，智能体可能采取多种有效行为，例如直接回答、请求澄清、提供进度更新或先确认再行动。这种灵活性破坏了基于组的强化学习的一个核心假设：组内轨迹不再保证行为可比。因而，奖励模型对交互风格的偏好可能扭曲相对优势，使优化偏向奖励偏好的行为而非上下文适当的行为。本文将此形式化为奖励偏差问题，并提出ARC框架，以在开放式交互中公平比较相对优势。该方法有望减少强化学习在真实世界应用中的偏好扭曲，提升行为适切性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open-ended real-world interaction admits multiple valid behaviors: an agent may answer directly, ask for clarification, provide progress updates, or confirm before acting. This flexibility breaks a core assumption behind group-based RL: rollouts compared within a group are no longer guaranteed to be behaviorally comparable. As a result, reward-model preferences over interaction style can distort relative advantages and steer optimization toward reward-preferred behaviors rather than context-appropriate ones. We formalize this as a \textit{reward…
items.why_zh: 开放式交互中的行为多样性破坏了组内比较的公平性，ARC提供了公平评估相对优势的方法。
items.why_en: In open-ended interactions, behavioral diversity breaks comparability; ARC ensures fair advantage evaluation.

items.title_zh: 基于本体的项目记忆：为编码代理提供结构化上下文
items.title_en: Ontology-Grounded Project Memory for Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 编码代理已成为许多软件项目生成新代码的主要手段，随之而来的高变更速度让跟踪代码变更背后的原因变得困难。本文介绍MOOSEDev系统，通过基于本体的结构化项目记忆为编码代理提供支持。该系统将架构决策、经验教训、约束条件和设计理由存储于知识图谱中，并通过模型上下文协议（MCP）接口暴露给代理。每条记录带有生命周期状态、来源和替代链接，便于追溯。借助这种项目记忆，编码代理能更好地理解项目历史，降低维护成本并提高代码质量。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13662v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coding agents have become the primary means of generating new code in many software projects, and the resulting velocity of changes makes keeping track of the reasons behind those changes challenging. This paper introduces MOOSEDev, a system designed to give coding agents structured, ontology-grounded project memory. The system captures architectural decisions, lessons, constraints, and rationales in a knowledge graph exposed to agents via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface. Records carry lifecycle status, provenance, and supersession links…
items.why_zh: 编码代理需要理解项目背景，基于本体的记忆提供了可追溯的上下文，对AI驱动的软件维护至关重要。
items.why_en: Structured project memory helps coding agents understand rationale behind changes, crucial for sustainable AI-driven development.

items.title_zh: AI研究偏好模型：优化研究预算分配
items.title_en: AI Research Preference Models
items.summary_zh: AI研究代理（AIRA）已能自主提出、实现并评估机器学习实验，但前沿任务的进展受评估成本制约：一个候选解决方案只需几分钟即可写就，而评估它可能耗费数小时到数天的GPU时间。因此，代理能提出的候选方案远多于其可负担运行的方案，其研究进度取决于如何分配固定执行预算，即研究偏好。本文提出AI研究偏好模型（RPM），用于预测多个候选方案中哪些更有价值。通过更优的预算分配，RPM能帮助研究代理聚焦高潜力实验，加速科学发现进程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13940v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI research agents (AIRA) can now propose, implement, and evaluate their own machine learning experiments, but progress on frontier tasks is throttled by cost: a candidate solution can be written in minutes, whereas evaluating it can take hours to days of GPU time. An agent can therefore propose far more candidates than it can afford to run, and its progress depends on its research preference: how it allocates a fixed execution budget across many candidates. We introduce AI Research Preference Models (RPMs) that predict which of multiple candidat…
items.why_zh: 研究预算有限时，RPM能让AI代理优先评估最有价值的实验，加速科研发现。
items.why_en: With limited compute, RPMs help AI agents prioritize high-value experiments, accelerating research.

items.title_zh: HELIX：模型-框架协同进化实现递归自我改进
items.title_en: HELIX: Model-Harness Co-evolution for Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary_zh: 本文提出HELIX，强调交互智能体的能力不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于运行时框架（harness）如何协调上下文、工具、控制流与停止机制。框架决定了模型能完成的任务范围及其学习轨迹。为此，作者提出模型-框架协同进化以实现递归自我改进：先为固定模型构建框架，再利用验证过的兄弟轨迹更新模型，最后随模型能力变化重建框架。实现该循环需要受控的机制。该思路将智能体能力提升从单纯模型扩展拓展到框架设计与模型学习的协同优化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13951v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling agent capability has largely focused on improving the model, yet an interactive agent acts through a runtime harness that mediates context, tools, control flow, and stopping. The harness shapes both what a model can accomplish and the trajectories from which it learns. This coupling motivates model-harness co-evolution for recursive self-improvement: build harnesses for a fixed model, update the model from verified sibling trajectories, and rebuild the harnesses as model capabilities change. Realizing this loop requires a controlled way t…
items.why_zh: 为提升智能体能力提供了模型与运行时框架协同进化的新范式，突破只改模型的传统思路。
items.why_en: It introduces a new paradigm where agent capability advances by co-evolving both the model and its runtime harness, not just the model alone.

items.title_zh: 基于 Treloar 经典数据集的数据驱动材料模型基准测试
items.title_en: Benchmarking data-driven material models on the classic Treloar dataset
items.summary_zh: 机器学习正迅速改变本构建模领域，提供直接从实验数据学习材料行为的新途径，并挑战传统建模范式。面对日益增多的基于机器学习的方法，它们在实践中的表现如何比较尚不清楚。本文使用 Treloar 的经典实验数据，对主流超弹性框架进行基准测试，包括（广义不变量）本构人工神经网络、物理增强神经网络以及（自适应）材料指纹等方法。研究为数据驱动材料建模的方法选择提供了统一的量化比较依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14063v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning is rapidly reshaping constitutive modeling, offers new ways to learn material behavior directly from experimental data, and challenges long-established modeling paradigms. But with a growing number of machine-learning-based approaches available, how do they compare in practice? In this paper, we use the classic experimental data of Treloar to benchmark popular frameworks for hyperelasticity: (Generalized-Invariant) Constitutive Artificial Neural Networks, Physics-Augmented Neural Networks, (Adaptive) Material Fingerprinting, and…
items.why_zh: 为数据驱动材料模型提供了基于经典数据的统一基准，有助于研究者在实际应用中做出方法选择。
items.why_en: It offers a standardized empirical comparison of key ML-based material models, guiding method selection in constitutive modeling.

items.title_zh: LLM 预训练中领域数据重复扩展的权衡研究
items.title_en: Scaling Domain Data Repetition in LLM Pretraining
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型规模的扩大，训练 token 预算也需要增加以维持合适的每参数 token 数（TPP）比例。然而，高质量领域数据比通用网页数据更难规模化，导致其在训练混合中的占比随模型规模和 token 预算增加而下降。重复利用现有的高质量领域数据是抵消这种稀释效应的有效手段，但过度重复可能导致过拟合。本文在实际的 LLM 扩展场景下研究了这一权衡，探讨如何平衡领域数据重复与模型泛化能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language models scale, their training-token budgets must also increase to maintain an appropriate tokens-per-parameter ratio (\(\mathrm{TPP}\)). However, high-quality domain data is much harder to scale than general web data. As model size and the training-token budget increase, its fraction in the training mixture tends to decrease. Repeating the available high-quality data provides an effective way to counteract this dilution, but excessive repetition may lead to overfitting. We study this trade-off under practical LLM scaling, where t…
items.why_zh: 为 LLM 预训练中如何最优利用稀缺高质量领域数据提供了关键权衡洞见，直接影响模型性能与数据效率。
items.why_en: It clarifies a critical pretraining trade-off between repeating scarce domain data and overfitting, informing data mixture design for large models.

items.title_zh: QuaSAR：基于稳定激活感知秩截断的量化补偿
items.title_en: QuaSAR: Quantization Compensation via Stable Activation-Aware Rank Truncation
items.summary_zh: 无需训练的后训练量化方法通常通过闭式残差补偿恢复模型精度，并通过拟合优度门控选择层以节省存储。本文发现，在低比特 W4A4 设置下，这种门控机制无法区分“量化误差本身难以预测”与“数值求解器失败”两种情况，而输入激活的秩亏会进一步干扰补偿。为此，文章提出 QuaSAR（稳定激活感知秩截断）以更可靠地实现激活感知的量化补偿。该工作揭示了现有门控策略的短板，并为低比特量化补偿提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent training-free post-training quantization methods restore model accuracy through closed-form residual compensation. To constrain additional model storage overhead, several existing methods gate layer selection by goodness-of-fit, retaining only those layers whose compensation yields a positive residual fit score and discarding the rest. In this paper, we show that, under the low-bit W4A4 setting, this gating mechanism fails to distinguish poorly predictable quantization error from numerical solver failure. Rank-deficient input activations y…
items.why_zh: 揭示了当前后训练量化中层选择门控的隐患，并提出了更稳定的补偿方法，有助于低比特量化的实际部署。
items.why_en: It uncovers a critical flaw in layer gating for post-training quantization and introduces a stable compensation approach, improving low-bit model deployment.

items.title_zh: 面向科技情报的高效多模态多语言观点提取：基于 QLoRA 的微调方法
items.title_en: Towards Efficient Multimodal and Multilingual Opinion Extraction for STI: A QLoRA-Based Fine-Tuning Approach
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型的进展重塑了语义分析。针对科技情报（STI）的观点提取需要从大量信息流中提炼简洁的核心观点，但现成模型难以过滤噪声，在零样本多语言和多模态场景下结构化输出可靠性有限。为应对信息过载与提取失焦，本研究提出一个多模态核心观点提取框架，将视觉证据作为上下文辅助，并采用基于 QLoRA 的高效微调方法，以提升多语言、多模态条件下的观点提取效率与准确性。该方法有望降低计算成本并增强模型对异构信息的处理能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have reshaped semantic analysis. Opinion Extraction (OE) for Science and Technology Intelligence (STI) requires concise core opinions from large information streams. Off-the-shelf models struggle to filter noise from these streams and show limited structured-output reliability in zero-shot multilingual and multi-modal settings. To address information overload and extraction defocus, this study proposes a multimodal core-opinion extraction framework in which visual evidence serves as a contextual anc…
items.why_zh: 针对科技情报场景中的信息过载和多语言多模态挑战，提出了一种高效微调框架，有助于自动化观点提取的落地应用。
items.why_en: It addresses information overload and extraction defocus in STI with an efficient QLoRA-based multimodal framework, advancing practical opinion extraction.

items.title_zh: 语言模型能理解毫米波数据吗？基于毫米波雷达人体理解的 LLM 基准测试
items.title_en: Can Language Models Understand mmWave Data? Benchmarking Large Language Models for mmWave Radar-Based Human Understanding
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型在推理和生成方面表现出色，促使研究者探索将其作为通用感知推理引擎。虽然视觉-语言模型已尝试融入视觉感知，但 LLM 与毫米波（mmWave）模态的结合——尽管毫米波在低光照和遮挡条件下具有独特优势——仍鲜有探索。主要瓶颈在于雷达-语言数据对稀缺、跨数据集异质性严重等。本文针对毫米波雷达人体理解任务对多种大语言模型进行基准测试，以评估它们理解毫米波数据的能力，为 LLM 在多模态感知中的应用提供参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14179v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable reasoning and generative capabilities, motivating their use as universal reasoning engines for perception. While modern approaches such as vision-language models (VLMs) have attempted to incorporate reasoning capabilities into visual sensing, the integration of LLMs with the millimeter-wave (mmWave) modality-despite its unique advantages under low light and occlusion-remains largely unexplored. The principal bottlenecks stem from the scarcity of radar language pairs, severe cross-dataset heteroge…
items.why_zh: 系统评估了 LLM 对毫米波雷达数据的理解能力，填补了 LLM 感知研究在多模态扩展中的空白。
items.why_en: It provides a systematic benchmark of LLMs on mmWave data, opening a new modality for language-model-based perception.

items.title_zh: 光谱基础模型预处理不变性的归因分析
items.title_en: Attributing Preprocessing Invariance in Spectral Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 预处理不变性是光谱基础模型理想的目标：冻结的模型应能在实验室采用不同预处理流程时依然有效。通常的测量方式是在一种预处理下训练分类器，在另一种下测试，将精度的保持视为模型学到了不变性。本文以拉曼光谱基础模型为案例重新审视了这一解读。这类模型在应用任何可学习参数前会先对输入进行归一化，而该归一化可能将不同预处理的光谱映射到相同的表示，从而“虚假地”带来不变性。作者对这种不变性的来源进行归因分析，提醒评估光谱模型鲁棒性时需谨慎。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14227v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Preprocessing invariance is an appealing goal for spectral foundation models: a frozen model should remain useful when laboratories preprocess spectra differently. It is usually measured by training a classifier under one preprocessing pipeline and testing it under another, with preserved accuracy read as evidence of learning. We revisit that reading, using a Raman foundation model as a case study. Such models normalize their inputs before any learned parameter is applied. If that normalization maps two differently preprocessed spectra to the sam…
items.why_zh: 质疑了光谱基础模型不变性评估的常用标准，提示归一化可能带来假不变性，对鲁棒性评估有重要警示。
items.why_en: It challenges the conventional measurement of preprocessing invariance in spectral models, warning that normalization can create illusory invariance.

items.title_zh: 无纠正控制的基础：大语言模型的真值追踪档案
items.title_en: Grounding Without Corrective Control: Truth-Tracking Profiles for Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 近期研究表明，某些大语言模型的表征具有内容或指称。基础（grounding）可以在不提供实时纠正路线的情况下锁定这些内容或指称，但作者追问这种缺失意味着什么。一个输出是“可回答的”（answerable），当差异能够影响目标与任务特定安排所产生、接受或撤回的内容。只有当实时且足够独立的路线能够检测和修复新的差异时，该安排才拥有“纠正控制”。路线档案（route profile）记录了哪些路线约束该安排以及它们如何起作用。本文为评估 LLM 输出的可靠性提供了一个新的分析框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14252v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent work suggests that some large language model representations have content or reference. Grounding can secure either without supplying live routes for correction. This paper asks what follows from that gap. An output is answerable when discrepancies can affect what a target- and task-specific arrangement produces, accepts, or withdraws. The arrangement has corrective control only when live, sufficiently independent routes can detect and repair fresh discrepancies. A route profile records which routes constrain the arrangement and how they a…
items.why_zh: 为理解大语言模型在缺乏外部纠正机制时能否真正追踪事实提供了新的理论框架，对可靠性评估具有指导意义。
items.why_en: It offers a new analytical framework for assessing whether LLM outputs can track truth without live corrective control, informing reliability evaluation.

items.title_zh: TimeSage-EV：演化环境中智能体时间序列分析的实时基准
items.title_en: TimeSage-EV: A Live Benchmark for Agentic Time Series Analysis in Evolving Environments
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍 TimeSage-EV，一个针对演化环境中智能体（agentic）时间序列分析的实时基准。高风险领域的时间序列分析依赖周期性发布的数据，新观测可能改变已有结论的证据基础；现有 QA 基准多基于固定快照，未评估时间有效性与截止感知。该基准覆盖 6 个领域的 60 个真实机构场景，包含 2023 年 2 月至 2026 年 5 月间的 1,485 个场景-周期问答对。它为检验模型能否基于最新数据并进行时间点感知推理提供了新的评测手段，有望推动时间序列分析基准向动态、真实环境演进。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time series analysis in high-stakes domains relies on recurring data releases, where new observations can alter the evidence base and the validity of later conclusions. Existing time series QA benchmarks mostly rely on fixed snapshots, leaving temporal validity and cutoff-aware evidence use unevaluated. We introduce TimeSage-EV, a live benchmark for agentic time series analysis in evolving environments. It tracks 60 real institutional scenarios across 6 domains, comprising 1,485 scenario-period QA pairs from Feb 2023 to May 2026 and spanning mont…
items.why_zh: 它填补了现有时间序列问答基准忽略数据动态更新与时间有效性的空白，使模型评测更贴近真实高风险应用。
items.why_en: It fills a critical gap in time series QA benchmarks by evaluating temporal validity and dynamic evidence use in evolving environments.

items.title_zh: AnchorBench：大语言模型锚定效应的多路径基准
items.title_en: AnchorBench: A Multi-Pathway Benchmark for the Anchoring Effect in LLMs
items.summary_zh: 锚定效应是指初始参考值会使人或模型的后续判断向其偏移的认知偏差。已有研究表明大语言模型（LLM）也会表现出类似行为，但现有相关基准通常只覆盖少量锚定路径，且很少区分无关锚与合理锚。为此，本文提出 AnchorBench，一个从多种锚定路径评估 LLM 锚定效应的基准，并设计了相关评估框架。该基准有助于更系统地衡量与理解大模型的锚定偏差，为提升模型判断稳健性提供评测基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The anchoring effect is a cognitive bias in which an initial reference value shifts a later judgment toward itself. This effect is well established in human judgment and decision-making, and recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) exhibit similar behavior. However, existing work on anchoring in LLMs typically evaluates only a narrow set of anchor pathways and rarely distinguishes irrelevant from plausible anchors. We introduce AnchorBench, a benchmark for the anchoring effect in LLMs that evaluates multiple anchor pathways under an…
items.why_zh: 它系统化了 LLM 锚定效应的评测，帮助识别和缓解大模型在决策中的认知偏差。
items.why_en: It provides a systematic evaluation of anchoring pathways in LLMs, essential for understanding and mitigating cognitive biases in model decisions.

items.title_zh: 清除迷雾：在 LLM Agent 中安装与优化主动探索能力
items.title_en: Clearing the Fog: Towards Installing and Refining Proactive Exploration Capabilities in LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨如何赋予大语言模型（LLM）智能体主动探索的能力，即主动获取信息以改进未来决策。作者首先识别出阻碍这一能力的两个根本瓶颈，随后提出一种新方法，由两部分组成：一是探索性数据构建，通过合成富含探索轨迹的数据来缓解标准演示中的后见偏差；二是强化学习优化，以进一步强化探索行为。该方法旨在让智能体在面对未知环境时更主动地收集信息，提升长期决策质量。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14339v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study proactive exploration in LLM agents, i.e., the ability to explore an environment to acquire information that improves future decision-making. In this regard, we first identify two fundamental bottlenecks that hinder this capability and then propose \ours, a novel method designed to instill and refine proactive exploration. Specifically, \ours\ consists of two components: (1) Exploratory Data Construction, which synthesizes exploration-rich trajectories to mitigate the hindsight bias of standard demonstrations; and (2) RL Optimization wit…
items.why_zh: 主动探索是智能体在开放环境中高效学习与决策的关键，该方法为提升 LLM Agent 的自主性提供了新路径。
items.why_en: Proactive exploration is crucial for agent autonomy and long-horizon decision-making; this work offers a concrete method to equip LLM agents with it.

items.title_zh: Tripwire：利用统计认证的安全神经元触发对齐拒绝
items.title_en: Tripwire: Triggering Aligned Refusal via Statistically Certified Safety Neurons
items.summary_zh: 神经元与路径级干预是防御大语言模型（LLM）越狱攻击的精细手段，但现有方法常以明显牺牲模型效用为代价。一类方法试图抑制有毒神经元来消除有害语义，但由于这些语义分散在网络各处，阻断所有通路会导致过大干预范围；另一类方法则依赖外部分类器识别安全神经元。本文提出 Tripwire，一种通过统计认证的安全神经元触发对齐拒绝的方法，旨在在保持模型可用性的同时实现可靠防御。该研究为 LLM 安全对齐提供了更精准的内部机制干预方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neuron- and path-level interventions offer the finest-grained route to defending large language models (LLMs) against jailbreak attacks, yet existing methods fall short of this promise, i.e., they often compromise model utility significantly. Specifically, one line of work suppresses toxic neurons to erase harmful semantics, but since such semantics are distributed across the network, blocking every pathway forces a large intervention footprint. An alternative line of research focus on identify safety neurons using external classifiers. While pro…
items.why_zh: 它探索了在不显著降低模型效用前提下防御越狱攻击的新机制，对提升大模型安全性具有重要意义。
items.why_en: It introduces a utility-preserving safety mechanism by leveraging certified safety neurons, advancing jailbreak defense in LLMs.

items.title_zh: 数据有限环境下 PM 预测的移位感知迁移学习与自适应双编码器融合
items.title_en: Shift Aware Transfer Learning with Adaptive Dual-Encoder Fusion for PM Forecasting in Data-Limited Environments
items.summary_zh: 在目标域观测有限且源、目标域统计特性存在差异时，短时程 PM2.5 预测仍颇具挑战：仅用本地数据训练难以刻画复杂的时序动态，直接迁移学习又可能导致负迁移。为此，本文提出一种移位感知的双编码器迁移框架，将源域知识与目标域特有的表示学习相结合。其中，源编码器利用源域数据预训练，并通过自适应融合机制适应目标分布。该方法旨在提升数据稀缺地区的 PM2.5 预测精度，为环境监测提供更可靠的模型支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14456v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Short-horizon forecasting of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) remains difficult when observations from the target domain are limited and the statistical properties of the source and target domains differ. In these settings, models trained only on local data may not capture complex temporal dynamics, while direct transfer learning can result in negative transfer. This study develops a shift-aware dual-encoder transfer framework that combines source-domain knowledge with target-specific representation learning. The source encoder was pretrained usin…
items.why_zh: 它为数据有限且存在分布差异场景下的细颗粒物预测提供了稳健的建模思路，具有很强的实际应用价值。
items.why_en: It addresses negative transfer and data scarcity in PM2.5 forecasting, offering a practical solution for environmental monitoring in data-limited regions.

items.title_zh: 参与式道德 AI 并非中立：开发者的无形之手
items.title_en: Participatory Moral AI Is Not Neutral: The Invisible Hand of Developers
items.summary_zh: 随着 AI 系统在社会中承担越来越多的道德决策，一种常见做法是开展道德偏好征集：研究人员就假设的道德困境对参与者进行调查，并用汇总的投票训练 AI 策略。本文指出，在投票开始之前，开发者已在道德 AI 引导流程中做出三个关键选择：特征范围、参与者抽样和问题框架。也就是说，开发者决定了哪些特征进入投票、选择哪些投票者以及如何呈现问题。这些看似中立的流程设计实际上会影响最终 AI 的道德取向，因此参与式道德 AI 并不能保证中立性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14522v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As AI systems make more morally loaded decisions across society, one response has been moral preference elicitation. In this approach, researchers poll participants on hypothetical dilemmas and use the aggregated votes to train a policy that an AI model then applies at scale. Before any vote is cast, developers make three key choices in the moral AI elicitation pipeline: feature scoping, voter sampling, and question framing. In other words, they decide which features go to a vote, which voters to include, and how to present the question. These ch…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了道德 AI 构建中容易被忽视的开发者偏见来源，对确保 AI 道德决策的公正性具有警示意义。
items.why_en: It exposes hidden developer biases in moral AI elicitation, challenging the assumed neutrality of participatory approaches.

items.title_zh: 跨会话边界的上下文学习状态交接
items.title_en: Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries
items.summary_zh: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）应用中的会话交接问题：当上下文长度达到模型输入限制、应用重启或由另一个智能体继续任务时，任务往往需要在新会话中延续，此时应用必须决定将上一会话的哪些信息传递给新会话。作者将交接形式化为任务相关上下文学习（ICL）状态的迁移，并区分了早期材料的精确恢复与保留之间的差异。这项工作为多会话 LLM 应用的状态管理提供了方法论和理论上的分析，有助于提升连续性任务的处理可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study investigates the methodological and theoretical properties of session handover in applications that use large language models. A task may continue in a new session when the context reaches the model's input limit, when the application restarts, or when another agent is asked to finish the task. The application must then decide which information from the earlier session to pass on. We formulate handover as the transfer of a task-relative in-context learning (ICL) state and distinguish exact recovery of earlier material from preservation…
items.why_zh: 它首次系统分析了 LLM 跨会话任务延续中的信息传递问题，对构建持久、稳定的智能体应用具有重要意义。
items.why_en: It addresses the underexplored problem of state transfer across sessions in LLM applications, key for long-running agent tasks.

items.title_zh: 经代理验证的 LLM UX 微模拟：面向早期决策支持的工件优先协议
items.title_en: Proxy-Validated LLM UX Micro-Simulations: An Artifact-First Protocol for Early-Stage Decision Support
items.summary_zh: 早期团队往往缺乏反复进行用户体验（UX）研究的用户、时间和预算，但仍需要决策导向的信号来安全迭代。本文提出一种由 LLM 驱动的 UX 微模拟流水线，可从版本化的提示、人物角色、任务和 UI 快照中生成结构化的客户体验反馈（如操作步骤、摩擦点、微调查信号）。由于公开的可用性数据集稀缺，作者利用多种公共代理语料（应用评论、支持推文和开源内容）对模拟出的摩擦主题进行验证。该方法为早期产品设计决策提供了一种低成本、可扩展的启发式评估途径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13563v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Early-stage teams often lack users, time, and budget to run repeated UX studies, yet still need decision-oriented signals to iterate safely. We study an LLM-driven UX micro-simulation pipeline that generates structured customer-experience feedback (walkthrough steps, friction points, micro-survey signals) from versioned prompts, personas, tasks, and UI snapshots. Because public usability datasets with task outcomes are scarce, we validate simulated friction themes using multiple public proxy corpora (app reviews, support tweets, and open-source…
items.why_zh: 它为资源有限的早期团队提供了一种快速、低成本的 UX 评估方法，有助于在开发初期发现可用性问题。
items.why_en: It enables early-stage teams to obtain decision-useful UX signals without extensive user studies, improving iteration safety.

items.title_zh: 勿将基准优化视为通用编程能力提升：需多样化评估
items.title_en: Don't Claim Benchmark-Oriented Optimization Improves General Coding Capability -- Diverse Evaluation Is Required
items.summary_zh: 该论文指出，后训练研究、模型卡和博客常将少数编程基准（如SWE-bench和LiveCodeBench）的高分作为模型具备广泛编程能力的证据。作者认为，针对这些基准的优化只能反映任务特定表现，导致测量分数与通用编程能力声明之间存在显著落差。为检验这一差距，他们构建了基于Django的案例研究基准套件，并对基础模型及后训练检查点进行评估。研究呼吁采用更多样化的评测方式，避免以单一基准成绩夸大模型的真实编码能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13566v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Post-training papers, model cards, and blog posts often treat scores on a small set of coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench and LiveCodeBench) as evidence of broad coding capability, both for research artifacts and user-facing systems. We argue that optimization for these benchmarks leads to measuring task-specific performance, creating a meaning gap between measured scores and claims of general coding ability. We examine this gap with a Django-based case study benchmark suite we create. Evaluating foundation models and checkpoints post-trained o…
items.why_zh: 该研究提醒AI社区切勿用狭窄基准分数宣称通用编程能力，对模型评估的可信度具有警示意义。
items.why_en: It cautions against equating benchmark scores with general coding ability, urging more rigorous evaluation practices.

items.title_zh: Jais 2：阿拉伯语中心的开源大语言模型家族
items.title_en: Jais 2: A Family of Arabic-Centric Open Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: Jais 2是由MBZUAI、Cerebras和Inception联合开发的阿拉伯语中心大语言模型家族，旨在推动阿拉伯语建模，并在阿拉伯语及文化相关基准上表现强劲。该家族包含目前已知最大的开源阿拉伯语中心模型，参数量达700亿，且从头训练；同时还有一个具有竞争力的80亿参数变体。自定义的阿拉伯语词汇表使其训练和推理更加高效。该模型家族为阿拉伯语NLP研究与实际应用提供了更强的开源基座。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13580v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Jais 2 is a family of Arabic-centric large language models developed jointly by MBZUAI, Cerebras, and Inception, designed to advance Arabic-centric language modeling, with strong performance across the Arabic and culturally grounded benchmarks evaluated in this report. The family includes, to our knowledge, the largest open Arabic-centric LLM trained from scratch at 70B parameters, and a competitive 8B-parameter variant among the evaluated open models. A custom Arabic-centric vocabulary enables efficient training and inference. In addition, an…
items.why_zh: 作为迄今为止最大的开源阿拉伯语大模型家族，Jais 2显著增强了阿拉伯语AI生态的技术实力。
items.why_en: As the largest open Arabic-centric LLM family, Jais 2 significantly advances Arabic-language AI capabilities.

items.title_zh: 从预测到干预：基于LLM智能体的个性化餐后血糖调控
items.title_en: From Prediction to Intervention: Personalized Meal-Level Glucose Regulation via an LLM Agent
items.summary_zh: 个性化血糖调控是精准营养中的核心难题，因为餐后血糖反应在不同个体间差异很大。传统依赖血糖指数的方法难以解释这种异质性，也缺少根据个人生理反馈动态调整餐食的机制。该研究借鉴基于LLM的智能体技术，提出一种生理反馈驱动的个性化血糖调控方法，利用上下文感知推理和迭代优化来制定干预策略。这为营养干预从静态预测走向动态个性化提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13581v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Personalized glucose regulation remains a central yet unresolved challenge in precision nutrition, as postprandial glucose response varies substantially across individuals. Existing approaches based on glycemic indices fail to adequately account for such heterogeneity and lack the mechanism to dynamically adjust meals based on personal physiological feedback. In this context, recent advances in LLM-based agents offer a promising direction, as they enable context-aware reasoning and iterative refinement. Inspired by this, we propose a physio-fee…
items.why_zh: 该研究将LLM智能体引入精准营养干预，有望实现真正个性化的餐食血糖管理。
items.why_en: It demonstrates how LLM agents can enable dynamic, personalized dietary interventions beyond static glycemic predictions.

items.title_zh: 无需训练的知识迁移：利用激活引导剪枝实现跨模型规模迁移
items.title_en: Training-Free Knowledge Transfer Across Model Scales through Activation-Guided Pruning
items.summary_zh: 异构模型融合旨在结合任务、初始化、架构或规模不同的模型，而该研究聚焦于被忽视的跨规模场景：在架构差异较大的情况下，用更强的捐赠模型提升较小的接收模型。作者基于一个观察——将大模型截断为较小架构并注入微小混合权重即可改善接收模型——提出激活引导的剪枝方法，无需显式的神经元级语义对齐即可实现能力迁移。该方法为跨规模知识迁移提供了无需额外训练的轻量路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13596v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Heterogeneous model fusion seeks to combine models that differ in tasks, initializations, architectures, or scales. We study an underexplored cross-scale setting: improving a small recipient language model with a stronger donor despite substantial architectural mismatch. We ask whether useful capabilities can be transferred without explicit neuron-wise semantic alignment. Building on the observation that truncating a large model to a smaller architecture and injecting it with a tiny mixing weight can already improve the recipient, we propose Ac…
items.why_zh: 提供了一种无需训练即可跨模型规模迁移知识的新方法，为小模型高效增强开辟了可能。
items.why_en: It offers a training-free, lightweight approach to knowledge transfer across model scales, potentially benefiting small-model enhancement.

items.title_zh: 推理数据选择受模型容量影响：高似然响应并非总是最优
items.title_en: Capacity-Dependent Effects of Data Selection for Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 在推理监督微调中，同一指令的不同候选响应与学生当前分布的匹配度差异显著。近期基于似然的响应选择方法认为，更接近学生分布的响应能提供更有效的监督，因此高似然响应或许普遍更受青睐。本文重新审视这一直觉，发现基于似然的数据选择价值关键取决于模型容量：在不同容量下，高似然响应的效果可能截然不同。该结果提醒研究者不能一概而论地采用似然准则，而需结合具体模型能力进行选择。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13721v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In reasoning supervised fine-tuning, candidate responses for the same instruction can differ substantially in how well they match the student's current distribution. Recent likelihood-based response selection methods suggest that responses closer to the student distribution provide more effective supervision, motivating the hypothesis that high-likelihood responses may generally be preferable for fine-tuning. In this paper, we revisit this intuition and show that the value of likelihood-based data selection depends critically on model capacity…
items.why_zh: 揭示了数据选择策略与模型容量之间的耦合关系，对推理微调的数据配比有实际指导意义。
items.why_en: It challenges one-size-fits-all likelihood-based data selection, showing capacity-dependent effectiveness in reasoning finetuning.

items.title_zh: 用AI构建AI密集型软件：早期结果与开发成本测量的警示
items.title_en: Building AI-Intensive Software with AI: Early Results and a Cautionary Tale on Measuring Development Cost
items.summary_zh: 关于AI密集型软件开发真实成本的实证报告仍然稀缺，而现有报告容易在最终数字中掩盖错误。一项正在进行案例研究显示，六人学生团队在一学期内借助广泛的AI辅助，构建了完整对话式入职助手，包括基于RAG的代码聊天、引导式导览、依赖图和技术债务分析。研究者采用三层成本模型对真实AI支出、人工努力等进行记录。早期结果既展示了AI辅助开发的潜力，也警示了成本测量的复杂性与易错性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13730v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Empirical reports on the true cost of AI-intensive software development remain scarce, and the few that exist are easy to get wrong in ways that never surface in the final number. We report early results from an ongoing case study: a six-person student team built a full conversational onboarding assistant -- RAG-based code chat, guided tours, dependency graphs, technical-debt analysis -- over one academic term using pervasive AI assistance. We instrumented development with a three-layer cost model (real AI spend, self-reported human effort, hum…
items.why_zh: 为AI辅助软件开发成本度量提供了实证框架，帮助业界更准确地评估AI投入的真实回报。
items.why_en: It provides empirical evidence on AI-assisted software development and warns against simplistic cost measurements.

items.title_zh: 放大不等于预测：思考模型中的推理行为与正确性关系
items.title_en: Amplified Does Not Mean Predictive: Reasoning Behaviors in Thinking Models
items.summary_zh: 该研究探讨在推理模型中，哪些推理行为与正确答案相关，以及推理导向的训练是否真正放大了这些行为。作者指出，推理训练可能让思维链看起来更具深思熟虑的风格，却并未放大与正确性最相关的行为。为此，他们提出了Behavioral Lift指标，用于量化某一行为在推理轨迹中出现与不出现时正确性的变化。实验覆盖15个模型和6个跨文本与视觉的基准，揭示了推理行为放大与预测性之间的系统性错位。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13760v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Which reasoning behaviors are associated with correct answers in reasoning models, and does reasoning-oriented training amplify those behaviors? This distinction is important because reasoning-oriented training can make traces look more deliberative without amplifying the behaviors most tied to model correctness. We quantify this mismatch with Behavioral Lift, a metric that measures how much correctness changes when a behavior is present versus absent in a model's reasoning trace. Across 15 models and 6 benchmarks spanning text-only and vision-…
items.why_zh: 区分了推理风格的增强与实质正确性的提升，对理解思考模型训练目标具有重要价值。
items.why_en: It separates style amplification from genuine correctness improvement in reasoning models, clarifying what training actually optimizes.

items.title_zh: 联邦提示学习：统一框架、实证分析与未来方向综述
items.title_en: Federated Prompt Learning: A Unified Framework, Empirical Analysis, and Future Directions
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型已成为云端智能服务的核心，但其训练和部署面临高计算成本、数据集中化和隐私问题等挑战。联邦学习通过去中心化训练范式，使客户端在无需共享原始数据的情况下协同训练模型，为隐私保护的LLM训练与推理提供了解决方案。该论文对联邦提示学习（FPL）进行了全面综述，提出了统一框架，并对现有工作进行了实证分析，最后展望了未来研究方向。文章梳理了FPL的关键技术路线与应用场景，有助于研究者快速把握这一新兴领域。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13844v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become core components of cloud-based intelligent services in academia and industry, yet their training and deployment are hindered by high computational costs, data centralization, and privacy concerns. Federated learning (FL) offers a decentralized training paradigm that enables clients to collaboratively train a learning model without sharing raw data, making it a promising solution for privacy-preserving LLM training and reasoning. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of federated prompt learning (FPL…
items.why_zh: 系统梳理了联邦提示学习这一隐私保护大模型训练的关键方向，为后续研究提供了清晰路线图。
items.why_en: It offers a comprehensive foundation for federated prompt learning, a key approach to privacy-preserving LLM development.

items.title_zh: 构建可靠编码智能体：评估与运维模型外围系统
items.title_en: Engineering Reliable Coding Agents: Evaluating and Operating the System Around the Model
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，AI 编码智能体通常被当作模型来评估，但在实际部署中是一个复杂系统，其可靠性不仅取决于模型能力，还受控于开发框架（harness）、执行状态、检索、记忆与状态管理、权限、审查接口和资源分配等系统要素。为此，作者提出了一套评估和运行编码智能体的框架，并通过对164篇学术文献、100份实践者记录、29份基准记录和17份作者-系统案例记录的结构化多声部综述来支撑该框架。该研究为工程团队在真实环境中可靠地部署和监控编码智能体提供了系统性的方法论。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13867v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI coding agents are commonly evaluated as models but deployed as systems. Their reliability depends not only on model capability, but on the harness, execution state, retrieval, memory and state management, permissions, review interfaces, and resource allocation. This monograph examines those boundaries and develops a framework for evaluating and operating coding agents reliably. It synthesizes 164 scholarly works, 100 practitioner records, 29 benchmark records, and 17 author-system case records through a structured multivocal review, targeted…
items.why_zh: 为编码智能体的可靠评估与运维提供了超越模型准确率的系统性框架，弥补了模型评估与实际部署之间的鸿沟。
items.why_en: Provides a system-level framework for evaluating and operating coding agents, addressing a critical gap between model evaluation and real-world deployment.

items.title_zh: 代理式编码时代人机协作的工程信号：vLLM 与 SGLang 33,228 个拉取请求分析
items.title_en: Engineering Signals of Human-AI Collaboration in the Agentic Coding Era: A Longitudinal Analysis of 33,228 Pull Requests from vLLM and SGLang with Implications for Biomedical AI Agents and Bioinformatics Pipeline Developmen
items.summary_zh: 该论文针对 AI 编程助手与自主代理开发系统快速普及的背景下，开源软件工程节奏和结构发生的变化，对 vLLM 和 SGLang 两个高速发展的 AI 项目中的 33,228 个已合并拉取请求（PR）进行了描述性纵向分析。研究跟踪了七项工程指标：PR 吞吐量、周期时间、贡献者多样性、PR 评论密度、合并率、新作者参与度和 PR 规模。这项工作补充了团队层面长期实证证据的不足，有助于理解 AI 工具如何实际影响开源协作模式，并为生物医学 AI 代理和生物信息学流水线开发提供借鉴。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13884v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid adoption of AI coding assistants and autonomous agentic development systems has coincided with major changes in the pace and structure of open-source software engineering. Yet empirical longitudinal evidence of these changes at the team level remains limited. We present a descriptive longitudinal analysis of seven engineering metrics: pull request (PR) throughput, cycle time, contributor diversity, PR comment density, merge rate, new-author participation, and PR size. Metrics were computed from all merged PRs in two high-velocity AI i…
items.why_zh: 大规模、团队级的纵向证据，首次系统揭示 AI 编码工具对真实开源项目工程流程的影响，并为相关领域提供参考。
items.why_en: Offers large-scale, team-level longitudinal evidence on how AI coding tools reshape open-source engineering, with direct implications for biomedical AI and bioinformatics development.

items.title_zh: CMCNet：对齐超声图像嵌入与文本 TI-RADS 表示实现甲状腺细粒度分类
items.title_en: CMCNet: Aligning Ultrasound Image Embeddings with Textual TI-RADS Representations for Fine-Grained Thyroid Classification
items.summary_zh: 超声是评估甲状腺结节的主要影像手段，ACR TI-RADS 框架通过五个超声特征类别将诊断标准化，并聚合为 TR1-TR5 五个风险等级。尽管临床广泛使用，但大多数深度学习方法只做良恶性二分类，多类预测和显式利用特征级监督的研究仍不充分，主要受限于标注数据有限。该研究引入包含 600 个甲状腺结节的 STN 数据集，并提出 CMCNet，将超声图像嵌入与文本 TI-RADS 表示进行对齐，以实现更细粒度的分类。这一思路有望在标注稀缺的情况下，借助领域知识提升模型对甲状腺结节细粒度分类的性能。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13939v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ultrasound is the primary imaging modality for assessing thyroid nodules, and the ACR TI-RADS framework standardizes diagnosis through five ultrasound feature categories that are aggregated into five risk levels (TR1-TR5). Although widely adopted in clinical practice, most deep learning approaches focus on binary malignancy classification, while multi-class prediction and explicit utilization of feature-level supervision remain underexplored, largely due to limited annotated data. In this study, we introduce the STN dataset of 600 thyroid nodul…
items.why_zh: 将文本化 TI-RADS 领域知识与图像嵌入对齐，为有限标注下的甲状腺结节多类细粒度诊断提供了新路径。
items.why_en: Aligns TI-RADS textual knowledge with ultrasound image embeddings, enabling fine-grained thyroid classification beyond binary malignancy under limited annotations.

items.title_zh: 音乐之镜：大语言模型在歌曲创作中作为共鸣板
items.title_en: Musical Mirrors: The LLM as Sounding Board in Songwriting
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文探讨了 AI 在创意实践中的一种不同用法：作为人类生成材料的阐释性“共鸣板”，而非常见的“AI 先行生成、人工再策展”模式。作者以哈特穆特·罗萨（Hartmut Rosa）的“共鸣”理论为透镜，对 2025 年 7 月至 2026 年 3 月间的歌曲创作进行了第一人称案例研究，涵盖 16 首原创作品（包括英语、法语及其他语言）以及钢琴独奏。论文描述了一种配置，其中共鸣并非发生在用户与模型之间，而是体现在作者自身创作体验的深化上。这为理解 LLM 如何辅助创作者深化个人表达提供了独特视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.13944v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper examines a use of AI in creative practice as an interpretive sounding board for human-generated material, rather than the more familiar pattern of AI generation followed by human curation. Through the lens of resonance as theorized by Hartmut Rosa, I present a first-person case study of songwriting from July 2025 to March 2026, drawing on 16 original pieces in English, French, and other languages along with piano solos. I describe a configuration in which resonance is not located between user and model, but in the author's deepening…
items.why_zh: 重新定义了大语言模型在创意实践中的角色——从内容生成器转向促进创作者自我反思与素材深化的共鸣板。
items.why_en: Shifts the role of LLMs in creative practice from content generation to a sounding board that deepens the author's engagement with their own work.

items.title_zh: 将视觉-语言-动作模型演进为可即时调用工具的智能体
items.title_en: Evolve Vision-Language-Action Model into an Agent with On-the-fly Tool-use
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出一种名为 ART（Agentic Robot with Tool-use）的工具注入框架，将端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与智能体的工具使用能力整合。ART 可对任意 VLA 模型进行调整，使其能够利用现成的工具模块来增强低层视觉、高层可供性和具身能力。与输出完整连续动作空间的普通 VLA 模型相比，ART 通过工具使用降低了动作解空间的复杂度，从而提高了跨任务泛化能力并减少了对训练数据的依赖。该方法为机器人智能体在动态环境中灵活调用外部工具提供了新的技术路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14047v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper integrates end-to-end Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models with agentic tool-use to propose Agentic Robot with Tool-use (ART). ART is a tool-injection framework that tunes any VLA model to leverage off-the-shelf tool modules for low-level vision, high-level affordance, and embodiment enhancement. Compared to vanilla VLA models with a whole continuous action solution space, ART reduces the complexity of the action solution space through tool-use, which not only improves generalizability across different tasks but also reduces data depe…
items.why_zh: 为 VLA 模型引入即用工具调用能力，显著降低动作空间复杂度，提升机器人智能体的泛化性与数据效率。
items.why_en: Enables VLA models to use off-the-shelf tools on the fly, reducing action-space complexity and improving generalization and data efficiency for robotic agents.

items.title_zh: 重新思考自动程序修复：缺陷复杂度、故障定位与 LLM 成本效益
items.title_en: Rethinking Automated Program Repair: The Impact of Bug Complexity, Fault Localization, and LLM Cost-efficiency
items.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动程序修复（APR）系统虽然展现出潜力，但以往研究大多只关注整体修复有效性，对缺陷复杂度、故障定位方式、推理设置以及修复成本效益的影响探讨不足。该论文对 LLM 驱动的 APR 进行了全面的实证分析，系统考察这些因素如何影响修复性能。研究结果有助于理解 APR 系统在真实缺陷场景中的表现边界，并为开发团队在资源受限条件下选择更高效的修复策略提供依据。这项研究也反映了将修复质量与成本一起权衡的新视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14065v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Background: Software bugs remain a critical challenge in development, necessitating effective Automated Program Repair (APR) techniques. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based APR systems have shown promise, prior studies primarily focus on overall repair effectiveness. The effects of bug complexity, fault localization, reasoning settings, and repair cost-effectiveness remain insufficiently explored. Aims: This study presents a comprehensive empirical analysis of LLM-based APR, focusing on how repair performance is shaped by bug complexity, fau…
items.why_zh: 填补了 LLM 自动程序修复领域对缺陷复杂度、故障定位与成本效率等因素系统性实证研究的空白。
items.why_en: Addresses the gap in LLM-based APR research by empirically analyzing how bug complexity, fault localization, reasoning settings, and cost-efficiency affect repair performance.

items.title_zh: P2Skill：云-本地 LLM 推理的隐私保护技能蒸馏
items.title_en: P2Skill: Privacy Preserving Skill Distillation for Cloud-Local LLM Inference Systems
items.summary_zh: 云-本地大语言模型推理系统希望在利用云端大模型强大推理能力的同时，保护个人设备上的敏感数据，因此发往云端的请求必须去除个人身份信息（PII），防止外部数据泄露。现有隐私保护方法如提示扰动、实体掩码或模型微调，往往会造成上下文语义扭曲或需要额外训练成本。该论文提出 P2Skill，一种基于提示的技能蒸馏方法，让本地模型在保护隐私的前提下获得云端模型的技能，同时避免上述副作用。这一方法为端云协同的隐私安全推理提供了一种更轻量、低成本的解决方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14094v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Cloud-local LLM inference systems have the potential to use the reasoning capability of large cloud models while protecting sensitive user data on personal devices. Cloud-bound requests must exclude personally identifiable information (PII) to prevent external data leakage. Existing privacy-preserving methods rely on prompt perturbation, entity masking, or model fine-tuning, but these approaches may distort contextual semantics or require additional training. This paper proposes P2Skill, a prompt-based skill distillation method in which a local…
items.why_zh: 为云-本地 LLM 推理提供了兼顾隐私与效率的技能蒸馏路径，避免现有方法带来的语义失真和训练开销。
items.why_en: Offers a privacy-preserving skill distillation approach for cloud-local LLM systems that avoids semantic distortion and training overhead of existing methods.

items.title_zh: 时间序列基础模型中的预测坍缩
items.title_en: Forecast Collapse in Time-Series Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 研究人员在预测 1,000 只美股的小时收益率时，发现预测结果几乎完全平坦，且基于横截面相关性衡量的股票排序表现不佳，他们将其命名为“预测坍缩”。令人意外的是，在相同设定下预测交易量时，该现象基本消失。研究者系统考察了时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）、12 个深度学习预测模型以及 97 个公共基准配置，发现这一现象与目标序列的可预测性密切相关。该发现对使用时间序列模型进行金融预测具有重要警示意义，提醒人们关注目标可预测性对预测质量的影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14106v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When forecasting hourly returns for 1,000 US equities, we observe an unexpected phenomenon: predictions become nearly flat and show poor stock ranking, as measured by cross-sectional correlation. We call this forecast collapse. Surprisingly, the phenomenon largely disappears when forecasting trading volume under the same setting. We investigate forecast collapse across time-series foundation models (TSFMs), twelve deep-learning forecasting models, and 97 public benchmark configurations, and find that it is closely tied to target predictability.…
items.why_zh: 首次系统揭示时间序列基础模型在低可预测性目标上可能出现的“预测坍缩”现象，对金融 AI 应用具有直接警示意义。
items.why_en: Systematically documents 'forecast collapse' in time-series foundation models, highlighting a critical pitfall for financial forecasting with deep learning.

items.title_zh: Act2Intention：通过 GUI 操作推断用户意图的主动移动代理基准
items.title_en: Act2Intention: A Benchmark For Developing Active Mobile Agents Through Inferring User Intention from GUI Actions
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出了 Act2Intention 框架，旨在通过整合用户意图的理解、预测和决策执行，构建主动移动智能体。研究者构建了 Act2Intention Bench 基准，用于评测移动 GUI 智能体从用户界面操作中推断意图的能力。研究指出，当前移动智能体主要依赖多模态大语言模型进行反应式任务执行，缺乏对用户意图的完整“理解-预测-执行”过程，而这正是主动智能体的核心需求。该工作为移动智能体从被动响应走向主动辅助提供了基准与方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14132v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mobile GUI Agents powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promise in human-computer intelligence. However, current research primarily focuses on reactive task execution while lacking a comprehensive understanding-prediction-execution process for user intentions, which are the core requirements of active agents. In this paper, we propose the Act2Intention framework that builds an active mobile agent by integrating understanding, predicting user intentions, and executing decisions. First, we construct the Act2Intention Bench thro…
items.why_zh: 该基准将用户意图推断引入移动智能体的主动能力评估，推动智能体从被动执行转向主动服务。
items.why_en: It introduces user-intention inference into mobile agent benchmarks, pushing agents from reactive execution to proactive assistance.

items.title_zh: 自监督视觉在线策略蒸馏
items.title_en: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文探讨视觉在线策略蒸馏中信息不对称的来源问题。传统方法依赖更强的教师模型或特权监督（如参考答案或真实目标区域）来提供不对称性，但作者提出：当没有任何特权信息时，不对称从何而来？他们通过反向思考，不向教师添加特权信息，而是从学生模型中减去信息，从而创造同样有效的学习信号。这一思路实现了自监督的视觉在线策略蒸馏，无需外部特权监督，为强化学习中的策略迁移提供了新视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14144v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Visual on-policy distillation relies heavily on an informative teacher-student asymmetry, through either a larger, stronger teacher or privileged supervision, such as reference answers or ground-truth regions of interest. This raises a fundamental question: where can informative asymmetry come from when nothing privileged is available? We answer this by inverting where the asymmetry comes from. Rather than adding privileged information to the teacher, we subtract information from the student. This asymmetry creates the same effective learning s…
items.why_zh: 该研究颠覆了知识蒸馏中教师-学生不对称的传统构建方式，为无特权监督下的策略蒸馏提供了新路径。
items.why_en: It rethinks teacher-student asymmetry, enabling on-policy distillation without privileged supervision.

items.title_zh: SimpleOPD：面向长上下文推理的简单分词器无关在线策略蒸馏
items.title_en: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在将长上下文推理能力从强教师模型迁移到短上下文学生模型时遇到的实际挑战，包括分词器不匹配、师生分布不匹配、响应长度爆炸和训练不稳定。作者将长上下文推理模型 SU-01 的证明推理能力蒸馏到短上下文学生模型中，并提出了 SimpleOPD 这一简单且与分词器无关的方法来处理这些差异。该工作旨在降低长上下文推理迁移的工程复杂度，使短上下文模型也能获得更强的推理能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14277v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a promising way to transfer reasoning capabilities from stronger teacher models, but applying it to long-context reasoning teachers and short-context students introduces practical challenges, including tokenizer mismatch, teacher-student distribution mismatch, response length explosion, and training instability. In this work, we study this setting by transferring proof-reasoning capabilities from the long-context reasoning model SU-01 to short-context student models. To handle tokenizer differences, we perfor…
items.why_zh: 解决了长短上下文模型间推理能力迁移的关键工程障碍，让在线策略蒸馏更简单实用。
items.why_en: It solves key engineering barriers in transferring reasoning to short-context models, making distillation more applicable.

items.title_zh: 见红思坏：视觉语言模型中的颜色偏见
items.title_en: Seeing Red, Thinking Bad: Color Bias in Vision Language Models
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在读取以图像形式呈现的文本时，视觉样式偏置对其输出产生的影响。作者引入“隐形视觉提示”（Stealth Visual Prompts），在不改变语义内容的前提下微妙调整文本的颜色、对比度等视觉样式，从而系统性地控制实验。通过该方法，研究者可以观察到颜色等视觉特征变化如何影响 VLM 的判断。鉴于 VLM 已应用于招聘支持和推荐等工业决策系统，这种颜色偏见可能带来不公平或错误的决策，具有重要的社会意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14286v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in industrial decision-making systems, such as recruitment support and recommendation. This motivates careful analysis of how VLMs process visual and textual information. In this work, we study how VLMs interpret text rendered as an image, and investigate the influence of visual styling biases. To this end, we introduce Stealth Visual Prompts, which subtly change visual styling of text, such as color and contrast, while preserving semantic content. Using these prompts, we systematically contro…
items.why_zh: 揭示了视觉语言模型中的隐蔽颜色偏见，可能影响招聘、推荐等自动化决策的公平性。
items.why_en: It uncovers subtle color biases in VLMs, raising fairness concerns in automated decision systems.

items.title_zh: 战场场景中的声学无人机检测：应对噪声、域偏移与弱标签
items.title_en: Acoustic UAV Detection in Battlefield Scenarios: Handling Noise, Domain Shift, and Weak Labels
items.summary_zh: 该论文针对战场环境中小型无人机的被动声学检测问题，提出了一种鲁棒检测框架。被动声学是一种关键、经济高效且隐蔽的探测手段，但极端环境噪声和异构硬件导致的域偏移严重制约其实际部署。作者将每通道能量归一化（PCEN）与基于注意力的池化相结合，以增强特征提取，并针对弱标签等实际难题进行优化。该研究有望提升声学无人机检测在真实战场条件下的可靠性与实用性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14287v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Passive acoustic sensing offers a critical, cost-efficient, and, crucially, passive alternative for detecting small unmanned aerial vehicles. However, the practical deployment of acoustic systems is discouraged by extreme environmental noise and sensor-induced domain shift caused by heterogeneous hardware. This paper addresses these challenges by introducing a robust framework optimized for real-world battlefield conditions. We propose the integration of Per-Channel Energy Normalization (PCEN) and attention-based pooling to enhance feature extr…
items.why_zh: 为极端战场环境下的无人机声学探测提供了可靠方案，具有重要的军事应用价值。
items.why_en: It enables robust passive drone detection in battlefield conditions, addressing practical deployment challenges.

items.title_zh: 基于二维平面图的机电管线（MEP）指标智能检测
items.title_en: Intelligent Detection of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) Metrics Based on 2D Floor Plans
items.summary_zh: 这项研究开发了一个基于神经网络的模型，用于从二维平面图中自动提取机电管线（MEP）相关信息。模型能够检测照明符号、识别灯具类型，并提取与灯具关联的文本。研究目标是辅助楼层设计，确定每层所需灯具的数量和类型，并估算平面图的电力需求。模型以 Mask RCNN 为基础，通过标注图像并转换为 COCO 数据集格式进行训练。该工作有望显著提高建筑设计中机电系统规划的效率，减少人工测量与估算工作。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14317v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This research developed a neural network-based model to extract various information from 2D floor plans. We detect lighting symbols, identify the appropriate type of light, and extract the associated texts with lights. The study aims to enable efficient floor designing and determining the number and type of lights needed per floor, i.e., allow efficient design and estimate the power requirement of the floor plan. The model was developed using Mask RCNN as the base. The images were annotated and converted into a Coco data format for training the…
items.why_zh: 将深度学习用于建筑平面图的机电系统自动化分析，有望显著提升设计效率。
items.why_en: It automates MEP metric extraction from floor plans, boosting design efficiency.

items.title_zh: 基于混合大语言模型的业务流程模型安全标注自动生成框架
items.title_en: A Hybrid LLM-Based Framework for Automated Security Annotation Generation in Business Process Models
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出了一种混合框架，以 BPMN 业务流程模型和安全需求文档为输入，自动生成符合 SecBPMN2 规范的安全标注。目前，从自然语言规格中推导准确且完整的安全标注仍依赖专家手动完成，耗时且易出错。该框架利用大语言模型结合其他方法（具体细节未在摘要中展开）实现标注自动化。这一研究有望降低安全业务流程建模的复杂度，提升标注的一致性与准确性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14370v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The modelling and analysis of secure business processes require the incorporation of security annotations into process models. Although BPMN extensions, including SecBPMN2, exist for this purpose, the derivation of accurate and complete security annotations from natural-language specifications remains a manual, expert-intensive, and error-prone task. This paper presents a hybrid framework that takes a BPMN process model and a security requirements document as input and automatically generates security annotations adhering to the SecBPMN2 specif…
items.why_zh: 利用大语言模型自动生成业务流程安全标注，有效降低人工成本和错误率。
items.why_en: It automates security annotation generation in business process models, cutting manual effort and errors.

items.title_zh: Reflex：面向反应关键型操作任务的快速预测视觉-语言-动作模型
items.title_en: Reflex: Enabling Fast and Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models for Reaction-Critical Manipulation
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出了 ReflexBench 基准，专门用于评估反应关键型操控任务中的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。现有基准大多聚焦于静态操控任务的泛化能力，忽略了动态交互场景。ReflexBench 包含六个动态任务，并引入了一套评估框架，将模拟器步进与机器人控制解耦，支持在同步和异步推理下配置延迟。该工作弥补了 VLA 模型在动态反应场景中的评估空白，有助于推动其在真实操控任务中的应用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14379v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved promising performance in robotic manipulation. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate generalization on static manipulation tasks and largely overlook dynamic interaction scenarios. To address this gap, we present ReflexBench, a benchmark for reaction-critical manipulation. ReflexBench contains six dynamic tasks and introduces an evaluation framework that decouples simulator stepping from robot control while supporting configurable latency under synchronous and asynchronous infere…
items.why_zh: 填补了视觉-语言-动作模型在动态反应型操控任务上的评估空白，推动其走向真实应用。
items.why_en: It fills the evaluation gap for VLA models on dynamic reaction-critical tasks.

items.title_zh: GBU-Palm：用于手掌呈现攻击检测的多模态视频数据集与基准
items.title_en: GBU-Palm: A Multimodal Video Dataset and Benchmark for Palm Presentation Attack Detection
items.summary_zh: 现有手掌呈现攻击检测（PAD）数据集多受限于静态图像、受限采集条件或缺乏多模态视频数据，难以支持跨环境、跨模态和跨攻击类型的系统性评估。为此，研究者提出GBU-Palm，一个大规模多模态视频数据集与基准。该数据集包含来自105名受试者、210只手掌的21,326段视频，覆盖真实、打印和重放三种呈现类型，在六种采集环境下录制，并包含6,310个RGB与近红外（NIR）同步样本。此外，数据集还采用了泄漏控制策略来划分训练与测试数据，以避免身份或传感器维度的信息泄漏。该基准有望推动手掌PAD研究向更真实、更严格的方向发展，并为多模态生物识别安全提供标准化评测平台。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14389v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Existing palm presentation attack detection (PAD) datasets are often limited by static imagery, restricted acquisition conditions, or insufficient multimodal video data, hindering systematic evaluation across environments, modalities, and attack types. We present GBU-Palm, a large-scale multimodal video dataset and benchmark containing 21,326 videos from 105 subjects and 210 palms across six acquisition environments, including bona fide, Print, and Replay presentations, with 6,310 synchronized RGB-NIR samples. We construct leakage-controlled pr…
items.why_zh: 该数据集填补了手掌防伪领域缺乏大规模多模态视频基准的空白，为跨环境与跨攻击类型的算法评测提供标准化平台，对提升掌纹识别系统的安全性至关重要。
items.why_en: It fills the gap of a large-scale multimodal video benchmark for palm PAD, enabling standardized evaluation across environments, modalities, and attack types, which is critical for securing palm recognition systems.

items.title_zh: 通过风险信息合成包络确保城市移动中的物理AI安全
items.title_en: Ensuring Safe Physical AI in Urban Mobility via Hazard-Informed Synthesized Envelopes
items.summary_zh: 随着各类异构机器人系统进入城市不同区域，在人机交互日益复杂的情况下，如何保障运行安全成为关键挑战。现有做法通常将安全约束视为单个软件模块内的静态限制，难以适应动态环境。研究者提出了一种统一框架，通过“风险信息合成安全包络”将系统性危害分析与运行时安全执行相衔接。该框架引入跨层安全转换流程，覆盖符号模型、空间模型和动态世界模型，使安全边界能够随环境变化不断更新。该研究展示了一种将安全分析结果直接嵌入运行时机制的自然接口方式，为城市环境中物理AI系统的安全部署提供新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14481v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As heterogeneous robotic systems deploy across diverse urban zones, maintaining safety amid complex human-robot interactions remains a critical challenge. We present a unified framework that bridges systematic hazard analysis and runtime enforcement using hazard-informed safety envelopes. Rather than treating safety as a static constraint isolated within individual software modules, we introduce a cross-layer safety transformation process spanning symbolic, spatial, and dynamic world models. We show how this representation naturally interfaces…
items.why_zh: 该研究将系统性危害分析与运行时安全执行统一进一个框架，使物理AI系统能够在动态城市环境中自适应更新安全边界，对复杂人机交互下的安全部署具有重要意义。
items.why_en: It unifies hazard analysis and runtime enforcement into one framework, allowing safety envelopes to adapt dynamically, which is crucial for safe deployment of physical AI in complex urban environments.

items.title_zh: 考虑交通流影响的道路养护作业最优调度
items.title_en: Optimal Scheduling of Road Maintenance Jobs Considering Impact on Traffic Flows
items.summary_zh: 道路养护规划通常需要反复求解在通行能力下降条件下的交通流均衡，传统交通分配模型虽然成熟，但在大规模网络中重复计算成本过高，难以直接嵌入养护作业的优化调度。该研究提出数据驱动的替代模型，直接从起讫点（OD）需求近似估计均衡弧流量，并以基于优化的均衡解作为监督训练的真值。通过这种方式，调度模型可以在无需反复求解复杂均衡问题的前提下，快速评估不同养护方案对交通流的影响。该研究还基于真实道路网络案例进行了分析，展示了替代模型在养护调度问题中的应用潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14491v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Network-level maintenance planning requires repeated evaluations of equilibrium traffic flows under road capacity reductions. While equilibrium traffic assignment models are well established, their repeated solution quickly becomes computationally prohibitive and challenging to embed within maintenance scheduling problems. This paper investigates data-driven surrogate models that approximate equilibrium arc flows directly from origin-destination demand, using optimization-based equilibrium solutions as ground truth. A real-world case study base…
items.why_zh: 该研究用机器学习替代传统交通均衡计算，大幅降低道路养护调度中重复评估流量的成本，使最优调度在大规模网络环境下变得可行，有助于减少养护施工对交通的干扰。
items.why_en: It replaces costly equilibrium traffic computations with machine learning surrogates, making optimal road maintenance scheduling feasible at scale and minimizing traffic disruption.

items.title_zh: 使用表格扩散Transformer生成基准健康数据
items.title_en: Generating Benchmark Health Data Using a Tabular Diffusion Transformer
items.summary_zh: 跨表格数据生成（CTDG）旨在从多个异构表格中学习生成模型并合成新数据，对于生成基准健康数据具有重要价值。然而，现有合成表格数据方法大多局限于单输入表场景，难以有效处理特征集多样的异构表。为此，该研究提出一个两阶段生成框架：第一阶段将每个异构原始表转换为标准化统计表示，以统一表结构和语义。研究者利用表格扩散Transformer作为生成模型，以支持跨表合成。该方法有望提高多表健康数据生成的质量与实用性，为隐私保护下的数据共享和基准测试提供新工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.14496v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Cross-Tabular Data Generation (CTDG) seeks to learn a generative model from multiple heterogeneous tables and produce new synthetic tabular datasets. However, existing synthetic tabular data generation methods are largely restricted to single-input-table scenarios and struggle to effectively handle multiple heterogeneous tables with diverse feature sets. items.why_zh: 健康数据通常分散在多张异构表格中，该方法通过两阶段框架与表格扩散Transformer突破单表限制，有助于在保护隐私的同时生成多样化的健康基准数据，支持下游模型开发与评测。
items.why_en: Health data is typically distributed across heterogeneous tables; this method breaks the single-table limitation by using a two-stage framework with a tabular diffusion Transformer, enabling privacy-preserving generation of diverse health benchmark data.
